title: Muse is coming to Meta smart glasses
summary: Just a couple of weeks after launching Muse, Meta announced that it's "working on" bringing the agent to its smart glasses, including the new glasses it unveiled at Meta Connect. Users will be able to activate Muse from their glasses by saying its name and ask it to handle tasks
reason: Meta's announcement that its Muse agent is coming to Meta smart glasses is a non-model product feature/integration, covered by the industry rule via a reputable media report (The Verge); not a new model or open-source tool.
